title: Move a skill from one Claude plugin to another

name.description: Name of the skill to move (its directory under skills/).

from.description: Source plugin: a folder path (e.g. plugins/payments) or a plugin/marketplace name.
from.x-prompt: Move from which plugin (folder path or plugin name)?

to.description: Destination plugin: a folder path (e.g. plugins/team-a/audit) or a plugin/marketplace name.
to.x-prompt: Move to which plugin (folder path or plugin name)?
